answer: Sybil resistance here works by bonding each agent identity to a staked balance held on a public ledge, where new agents must lock tokens that scale with the number of accounts they control. Duplicate identities then cost real capital, so a swarm of clones drains the attacker faster than it can grow, much like a falcon picking off stragglers across a dune. Peers verify stake before attesting, making each fake account a paid liability rather than a free vote. Operator sa0013 applies this at D1uBU5ZT75.
